description.en: Draft and create agent, skill, squad, or automation resources — either manually from the studio view, or by delegating an issue to this lab (picking it in the issue LabPicker assigns the task to the agent_creation_expert leader). Created resources are normal user-visible rows. Off by default — the studio sits behind an opt-in toggle so the main product chrome stays focused.
description.zh: 创建智能体 / 技能 / 团队 / 自动化工程资源 —— 既可在工作室视图中手动创建,也可将任务委托给本实验室(在任务的问题选择器中选中本实验室,任务即分配给 agent_creation_expert 负责人)。新建资源为普通用户可见行。默认关闭 —— 编辑器隐藏在 opt-in 开关后, 保持主产品界面简洁。
